I will plough this quarter-hectare plot with my oxen when the meher rains begin, and I will sow barley seed I saved from last year's harvest. I managed to get a small amount of DAP and urea from the cooperative this season, though not as much as I hoped, and I will also spread manure from my cattle because the soil needs whatever help it can get. My wife and children will handle the weeding and harvest themselves since the plot is small and hiring labor is too expensive for a barley field.
